visualize_depth_map: create a colored visualization of a depth map using the magma colormap with gamma correction
visualize_depth_directory: convert a directory of raw depth files to colored PNG visualizations with consistent scaling
create_video_from_images: create an MP4 video from a sequence of images using ffmpeg at 30fps with libx264 encoding
apply_mask_to_image: apply a binary mask overlay to an image with a configurable mask color and alpha blending
review_visualize_depth: review the visualize_depth function to understand how it rescales depth values and applies the magma colormap
